newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise Jan/Feb rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise Jan/Feb rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it will raise the margin requirements on its January and February rubber futures contracts effective from Tuesday.

It will raise its margin requirement on the January contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, bringing the total January requirement to 147,750 yen. The margin for the February contract will increase by 10,000 yen per lot to 62,500 yen.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
